standard_prerequisites.use: The first handles the case where the component is not contained in the divisor, identifying the two intersections as inverse images, and the second handles the case where it is, where the equality is the compatibility of the cap with flat pullback.

standard_prerequisites.name: Infinite sums of rational equivalences
standard_prerequisites.use: Extends the equality from a single integral class to a general cycle.

core_obligations: Reduce to an integral class and split into the two cases according to whether it is contained in the divisor, obtaining in the first case the equality of cycles through the identification of the intersections as inverse images (proof lines 5320-5328).
Settle the second case by the compatibility of the cap with a first Chern class and flat pullback (proof lines 5329-5331).
Extend to general cycles by the statement on infinite sums (proof lines 5332-5333).
proof_roadmap: Reduction and the not contained case (proof lines 5320-5328).
The contained case via the cap compatibility (proof lines 5329-5331).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the Gysin map commutes with a flat pullback of the ambient scheme, on the level of cycles (statement lines 5302-5318, tag 02TP-adjacent). The proof reduces to an integral class, splits into the cases according to whether it is contained in the divisor, uses the identification of intersections as inverse images in the first case and the compatibility of the cap with flat pullback in the second, and extends to general cycles by the infinite sums statement. The two-case analysis is the substance, so the claim is H2.
